title: Multi-modal multi-task learning for joint prediction of multiple regression and classification variables in Alzheimer's disease

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Multi-modal multi-task learning for joint prediction of multiple regression and classification variables in Alzheimer's disease》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Many machine learning and pattern classification methods have been applied to the diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and its prodromal stage, i.e., mild cognitive impairment (MCI).

evidence.text: Many machine learning and pattern classification methods have been applied to the diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and its prodromal stage, i.e., mild cognitive impairment (MCI).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Multi-modal multi-task learning for joint prediction of multiple regression and classification variables in Alzheimer's disease》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】To validate our method, we perform two sets of experiments on ADNI baseline MRI, FDG-PET, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) data from 45 AD patients, 91 MCI patients, and 50 healthy controls (HC).

evidence.text: To validate our method, we perform two sets of experiments on ADNI baseline MRI, FDG-PET, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) data from 45 AD patients, 91 MCI patients, and 50 healthy controls (HC).
